name: genpark-manus-autonomous-web-browser-dom-actuator-skill
description: Manus & Adept ACT-1-inspired Autonomous Web Browser DOM Actuator. Flattens DOM trees into accessibility trees (AXTree), prunes non-interactive noise, synthesizes robust CSS/XPath locators, and compiles goal-driven multi-step automation plans with verification checks.

tools.name: compile_dom_action_sequence
tools.description: Parse DOM element nodes and generate an execution plan for a web automation goal.

goal.description: User intent (e.g., 'Book flight CDG to JFK' or 'Checkout cart').

raw_dom_elements.description: DOM nodes with tag, id, text, role, is_visible, and attributes.
